question: How much held-out state variation does a fixed position-conditioned FIT mean explain, compared with global FIT mean and existing PCAk8/16?

design.question: How much held-out state variation does a fixed position-conditioned FIT mean explain, compared with global FIT mean and existing PCAk8/16?
design.evidence_class: Post-hoc descriptive saved-only compression diagnostic; no new confirmatory claim
design.source_cohort: Frozen32FIT/32TEST sources,112rows each; same block-output cut0 and full tokens as dictionary pilot.
design.fitting: Single pooled FIT global vector and token-position matrix; equal weight per source then case then token. No domain-specific fitting.
design.scoring: Per-model/domain and ALL source-weighted state MSE, normalized by domain TEST variance about its own global feature mean and separately by globalFITmean error. TEST means are denominators only.
design.interpretation: Position-conditioned mean, not causal positional-embedding attribution; shared structure may include common content. Fixed means have identically zero response to input perturbations at fixed shape.
design.parameters: Global mean D; position mean T*D; PCA stored D*D basis+D center+1 scale (k is fixed metadata), dynamic up-to-T*k coefficients and indices per input. PCA is full-basis token-adaptive TopK, not fixed rank-k projection.
design.checks: Known-answer, TEST poison, unequal-source weighting, overlap, PCA selection tests; isolated mutation subprocesses before real scoring; independent saved reconstruction/source arithmetic replay.

independent_replay.method: No production fit/weight/scoring/PCA functions imported. Source-first FIT means; float64 coefficient projection with independent argpartition selection; compensated scalar arithmetic from saved reconstructions.

limitations: Position-conditioned means may encode shared content, normalization or token roles; no causal position-embedding attribution.
Static means respond identically zero to fixed-shape input perturbations; global compression is distinct from input-information or weak-response preservation.
Four independent TEST sources per real domain; sixteen synthetic. Source-weighted global score gives synthetic half the mass.
TEST variance is a scoring denominator only; negative reductions on individual domains are possible.
Raw hidden-state MSE units are not comparable between models. PCA controls use input-dependent sparse coefficients and far more stored parameters.
Post-hoc descriptive analysis on reused cohort, without confidence intervals, tuning or new model inference.
evidence_class: Post-hoc descriptive saved-only compression diagnostic; no new confirmatory claim
next_decision: Use this baseline to qualify global compression claims; it neither proves nor disproves interpretability. No native or dictionary-training expansion.
interpretation: Pooled position-conditioned FIT mean removes80.30466851357155% of Bolt and10.107015663060814% of TimesFM error relative to the pooled globalFIT mean.
PCA remains substantially better: error/globalFITmean ratios Bolt0.021846093615440033(k8)/0.009173964053706064(k16); TimesFM0.08610490644031232/0.04259929649012923.
TimesFM synthetic positionmean ratio1.04555521 is worse than globalFIT mean; pooled averages mask domain differences.

Static shared structure qualifies global compression; fixed position means cannot carry input perturbation responses, and this does not disprove interpretability or identify causal positional embeddings.
